messages:
Sam: Heads-up — I opened a PR with updated wording around audit log retention and an SDK snippet migration for Go/Node. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 :eyes:
DocBot: PR #4822 opened by Sam — draft docs/compliance/audit-log-retention.md
Lina: Thanks — I skimmed it. Two quick notes: the Go snippet still uses `ttl_days` but our canonical param in SDK v2 is `retention_days`. Can switch that in-place.
Sam: Good catch. Lina, can you push that change or point me to the exact file?
Lina: Pushed a small follow-up commit with the param rename and a couple of import fixes. Also added a short inline example showing KMS header. Example:
```go
// set retention when exporting audit logs
client.ExportLogs(ctx, ExportOptions{RetentionDays: 90, RedactPII: true})
```
Lina: Note: I used 90 days in the example to be conservative; we shouldn't claim longer defaults without legal sign-off.
Marta (Legal): Quick guidance from legal: do not use phrasing like "we retain logs for X by default" unless that's an enforced product default. Prefer: "Customers can configure retention; example shows 90 days." Also avoid implying Redwood can access customer content indefinitely — use "export window" or "retention window" language.
Harry: From infra side — add a short note about backups/archival vs. product retention. Customers sometimes assume retention==backup. Suggest sentence: "Retention controls data shown in exports; backups/archives may persist per our backup policy and are accessible only under legal process"
Kevin (SDK): For the SDK snippet tests I need an acceptance checklist: (1) sample compiles, (2) snippet uses stable API surface (no internal types), (3) link to SDK reference included. Also can we confirm whether `ExportLogs` is in v2 or behind feature flag?
Lina: `ExportLogs` landed in v2 last week; it's GA in hosted but still behind feature-flag for Dedicated customers. I'll annotate the snippet with a short note: "requires Export feature flag in Dedicated".
Sam: Marta — can you suggest exact alternative wording for the top-level doc paragraph? Current draft: "Redwood retains audit logs for 90 days by default." Want to avoid that.
Marta (Legal): Suggest: "Example retention window: 90 days (configurable). Customers should confirm their required retention periods for compliance. Redwood supports configurable retention and export features; backups are governed by our internal backup policy and legal processes"
Sam: Perfect — I'll swap that in.
DocBot: Lint check passed for docs/compliance/audit-log-retention.md (link-checker: 12 links verified)
Kevin (SDK): One more: update the Node snippet to use the new option name too and add a short test matrix line in SDK CHANGELOG so docs automation can pick it up.
Lina: Node snippet updated in commit 3. I used this pattern:
```js
// export with retention in Node SDK v2
await client.exportLogs({ retention_days: 90, redact_pii: true })
```
Lina: Also added a small redaction example showing prefix-based masking and a link to the redaction guide.
Harry: Ops question — do we need to add a small note about tenant separation? A one-liner: "Exports are scoped to the requesting tenant and require appropriate IAM permissions."
Marta (Legal): Yes include that. And one more legal nit: avoid saying "permanent" or "never" in retention context. Use "longer-term archive" + "legal process" instead.
Sam: Action items: (1) merge Lina's param/name fixes and snippets, (2) update top paragraph with Marta's wording, (3) add Harry's tenant/backup clarifications, (4) Kevin to add SDK CHANGELOG entry for snippet compatibility. I'll re-run link-check and request reviews from infra and legal once done.
Kevin (SDK): I'll prepare the changelog PR today and ping CI.
Lina: Merged the wording commit and pushed a tiny follow-up to add the feature-flag note.
Sam: Thanks all — tagging for final quick reviews: @Marta (Legal) @Harry. If no objections by EOD I'll merge and then follow up with a tiny migration note for Dedicated customers. :white_check_mark: 
Marta (Legal): Reviewed — looks good with the updated phrasing.
Harry: LGTM, added a tiny ops link to the backup policy.
Sam: Merged. Closing thread.
